note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. CON-RDS01 is a throwaway Desktop Experience VM (Server Core has no RD Session Host). If New-RDSessionDeployment restarts the server during the apply screen, the PowerShell Direct session ends: sign in again and re-run the same Apply command (the plan is rebuilt from the facts). The RDP session for the sessions screen is made by the owner on CON-SRV02 (mstsc).
prepare: # owner creates CON-RDS01 (Windows Server 2025 Datacenter Evaluation, Desktop Experience, 10.50.0.44, domain-joined): see needs vm:CON-RDS01
Invoke-Command -Session $r { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep11 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
$pw = Read-Host -AsSecureString "Password for alex.demo (owner types, never shown)"

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $pw { param($p) if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'alex.demo'")) { New-ADUser -Name "Alex Demo" -SamAccountName alex.demo -UserPrincipalName alex.demo@lab.contoso.com -AccountPassword $p -Enabled $true } else { Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity alex.demo -Reset -NewPassword $p; Enable-ADAccount -Identity alex.demo }; if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'sam.demo'")) { New-ADUser -Name "Sam Demo" -SamAccountName sam.demo -UserPrincipalName sam.demo@lab.contoso.com -Enabled $false } }

screens.name: sessions
prepare: # owner signs in: on CON-SRV02 run mstsc /v:con-rds01.lab.contoso.com, sign in as CONTOSO\alex.demo (typed off camera), open Notepad, then close the RDP window with the X (disconnect, not log off)
Read-Host 'Press Enter when alex.demo is disconnected' | Out-Null
commands: Get-RDUserSession | Format-Table UserName, HostServer, SessionState, UnifiedSessionId

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-RDS01 -Credential $cred { Remove-RDSessionCollection -CollectionName "MG Lab Desktops" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep11 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

$vm = Get-VM -Name CON-RDS01 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($vm) { $disks = @($vm | Get-VMHardDiskDrive | ForEach-Object Path | Where-Object { (Split-Path $_ -Leaf) -like "CON-RDS01*" }); Stop-VM -VM $vm -TurnOff -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-VM -VM $vm -Force; foreach ($d in $disks) { Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $d) -File -Filter "CON-RDS01*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { Remove-ADComputer CON-RDS01 -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ADGroup "RDS Demo Users" -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ADUser alex.demo -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ADUser sam.demo -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
